newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs up 2.99 pct on telcom, power sectors.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs up 2.99 pct on telcom, power sectors.

text.p: Brazilian shares were 2.99 percent higher in moderate mid-morning trade on heavy buying of telecommunications and power stocks, brokers said.

The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 47 most active stocks was up 367 points at 12,602 points. Market turnover was 379 million reais ($359 million), with analysts projecting a total volume of 1.9 billion reais for the day.
Traders said remarks by Communications Minister Sergio Motta gave a boost to benchmark Telebras and its subsidiaries.
Motta late Tuesday said the government expected to complete the privatization of federally-owned Telebras system by the middle of next year.

Telebras preferred was up 2.91 percent at 159 reais. Federal power utility Eletrobras jumped 4.02 percent to 621 reais, leading the rise in the electrical energy index .IEE, which jumped 2.08 percent to 3,444 points. ((--Fatima Cristina, Sao Paulo newsroom 5511 2485412))
